comment: Flange per the CAT40 (V-flange) standard (ASME B5.50, flange 2.50 in = 63.5 mm); the body and nose are a conservative generic envelope for collision checks; chuck body about 52 mm across, tapering to 40 mm at the jaws. Measure your own holders and correct the segments.
name: CAT40 keyless drill chuck 0-1/2 in, 100 mm gauge
